race.comment: GRACEFUL THINKING (10) was a well-supported favourite on debut and was fair to the line when fourth; she has the pedigree and stable profile to improve sharply from that experience, with the rise to 1200m looking to suit. O'HATASKY (11) was more professional first-up, finishing third in the same race and holding a small edge over GRACEFUL THINKING on that meeting. McDougall rides now and she can continue to build. CLYDE MOUNTAIN (3) can't be left out of calculations first-up with a solid trial and soft draw on offer. Heywood's booking is a positive sign and he's worth keeping safe. MACHRIHANISH (8) was solid here fresh before a 2.5L defeat at Muswellbrook last time. Can play a leading role.
